commit.message:
Fix `tib` type declaration

From Dean's comment, which was helpful to understand the difference:

> The problem is PNT_TIB is a typedef of a pointer type, so "const
> volatile PNT_TIB" is the same as "PNT_TIB const volatile". I think
> what you need is "const volatile TEB *" or an equivalent
> VOLATILE_PNT_TIB typedef.
